item: Boot page check: the file's pages against its header's, read at every open and kept on the journal's open event as a fact
key_paths: src/monitoring/page_reading.py; src/monitoring/forensics.py; src/monitoring/storage_events.py; src/api/main.py; src/api/unlock.py; src/database/writer.py; tests/test_page_reading.py; tests/test_storage_events.py; tests/test_runs_log_sinks.py
summary: Two sources (the header bytes at boot with no engine, PRAGMA page_count off the verify connection at an unlock), difference only from a valid header, one WARNING line when the file holds more pages than the header counts, never a verdict; the journal's reset removes the paths it used, the two helpers the log guard excuses by name have their bodies pinned, and the write gate's release and watchdog lines scrub the holder's name.
